title: Intermittent gateway failures
summary: edge-gateway requests failed only in one availability zone

logs: gateway WARN upstream reset in az3

runbooks.title: Packet loss in one zone
runbooks.content: Zone-specific resets and dropped packets require comparing network path configuration such as MTU before changing application timeouts.

oracle.root_cause: An MTU change to 9000 in az3 caused fragmentation loss and intermittent gateway resets.
remediation: Alert on packet loss by zone
